## Summary

Describe the feature and the user need.

## Proposed Solution

Explain the preferred behavior or implementation approach.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe other approaches considered, if applicable.

## User and Access Scope

Identify whether this applies to public visitors, verified students, administrators, or internal operations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The feature behavior is clearly defined.
- [ ] API and UI changes are identified.
- [ ] Security implications are addressed.
- [ ] Tests are identified.
- [ ] Documentation changes are identified.

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, designs, links, or other supporting context.
